description: Unit tests for the AlpsDecoder class in the net:: namespace, testing parsing of SPDY protocol frames related to ALPS (Accept-CH and Settings frames).

classes.name: AlpsDecoder
classes.description: Class responsible for decoding ALPS frames in SPDY protocol.

methods.name: GetAcceptCh
methods.description: Returns the list of Accept-CH origin-value pairs parsed from frames.

methods.name: GetSettings
methods.description: Returns the list of settings parsed from frames.

methods.name: settings_frame_count
methods.description: Returns the number of settings frames processed.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes a given SPDY frame and updates internal state accordingly.
